title: Reconciliation tolerance policy
description: How large a signed plan-ledger residual may be at submission and how it is closed. Spec ACC09 (tolerance default 0 with epsilon 1e-6; site policy may approve percent or absolute; residual always stored; within-tolerance residual becomes a labelled `tolerance_adjustment` line; zero target allows absolute tolerance only) and ACC10 (positive residual beyond tolerance needs an explanation or an explicitly allowed `Unaccounted` classification). Decision D06. Consumed by sub-phase 2.8 on `submit`; versions recorded on every calculation run (2.5).

mode.description: `zero`: any |residual| > epsilon blocks submission. `percent`: tolerance = value % of the slice target (meaningless when target = 0, so the engine falls back to zero tolerance there per ACC09). `absolute`: tolerance = value in the slice unit of measure.

value.description: Tolerance magnitude. Percentage points for `percent` (0.1 = 0.1 %), quantity in the slice UoM for `absolute`, must be 0 for `zero`.

epsilon.description: Decimal comparison epsilon: |residual| <= epsilon is treated as exactly zero (ACC09). Not a tolerance; never creates an adjustment line.

allowUnaccountedClassification.description: When true a positive residual beyond tolerance may be closed with an explicit `unaccounted_classified` line that the approver accepts (ACC10). Off by default (D06).

unaccountedTargetOfShortfall.description: SME R7 (14 Oct 2026): improvement target for unexplained loss (positive residual, tolerance adjustments and classified Unaccounted lines) as a share of the shortfall (plan - actual). Reporting only, never the approval tolerance; absent or null = no target.

submitGate.description: SME D12 (15 Oct 2026): before a shift period is submitted every stop needs a specific reason or 'investigation pending' and the coded share of stopped time (coded_downtime_ratio) must reach codedRatioTarget. `warn` shows the result on the period page, `block` refuses the submission (422 CODING_INCOMPLETE). Absent = warn at 0.95.

bridgeLimits.description: SME R8 (15 Oct 2026): per-unit bridge limits (null = no limit). A bridge line above `absolute` (slice unit of measure) or `relative` x the slice plan target needs a second independent reviewer before approval (`second_review`) or is refused at save (`refuse`). Absent = no limit.

reversibleKinds.description: SME R9 (15 Oct 2026): loss kinds an evidence-backed `reversal` line may reverse (an approved line of an earlier period of the unit). Absent = every kind listed here.
